analysis.title: GS Korea Final - US Tech Earnings Spillover
key_insights: KOSPI closed -3.48% at 5730.7 on 30 Oct 2026, with turnover of US$14.4bn. Underwhelming US tech earnings weighed on Korean equities and AI sentiment.
Samsung Electronics (005930) fell 3.0% and SK Hynix (000660) fell 7.1%, giving back part of their week-to-date rally. Hynix had risen 19.5% week to date before the session.
The US tech earnings cited as the trigger were Amazon (miss on sales and EPS) and Intel (revenue miss). Softer sentiment after Samsung's earnings call the day before added to the selling.
Foreigners were net sellers of KOSPI at US$1,212mn, concentrated in tech. They sold Hynix (-US$321mn) and Samsung (-US$158mn). Locals (+US$557mn) and retail (+US$465mn) bought the dip.

GIR kept its Buy (CL) rating on Samsung Electronics. GIR expects a W70tn year-end shareholder return announced at the Jan 2027 earnings call, made up of about W40tn in cash dividends and about W30tn in buybacks and cancellation. GIR describes it as a matter of when, not if.
SK Hynix saw Other Corporates inflow for a second consecutive day (+US$252mn) after its announced W20tn buyback.
Cosmetics were mixed. Amorepacific (090430) rose 3.8% and Amorepacific Holdings (002790) rose 7.4% on in-line 3Q results. APR (278470) fell 7.6% after its 3Q operating profit missed.

Amorepacific 3Q26 revenue rose 11% YoY to W1.1tn and operating profit was W115bn, broadly in line with GSe and consensus. Overseas revenue rose 12% YoY, led by the Americas (+17%), EMEA (+10%) and Other Asia (+20%). Greater China revenue fell 2% YoY, against the roughly 10% decline GIR had anticipated.

Hanmi Pharm (128940) rose 6.8%. Efe, Korea's first domestically developed GLP-1 obesity treatment, began prescriptions at select medical institutions on 29 Oct after MFDS approval on 7 Oct. Local institutions were the only net buyers.

market_movers.rationale: GIR kept its Buy (CL) rating on Samsung Electronics (005930). It expects a W70tn year-end shareholder return, about W40tn in dividends and about W30tn in buybacks, announced at the Jan 2027 earnings call.

sector_views.rationale: The desk marks semis (-) after Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix gave back part of their weekly gains on weak US tech earnings and softer sentiment after Samsung's earnings call.
The desk marks cosmetics (=). Amorepacific results were in line while APR missed.

earnings_insights: Amazon missed on sales and EPS (reported results cited as a driver of the Korean selloff, no figures given).
Intel missed on revenue (reported, no figures given).
Amorepacific 3Q26 (reported after the bell on 29 Oct): revenue W1.1tn, +11% YoY. Operating profit W115bn. Broadly in line with GSe and consensus.
APR 3Q operating profit W160.6bn reported intraday, a 7% miss against the Bloomberg estimate of W172.9bn.
risk_factors: Further weak US tech earnings could keep pressure on Korean AI and semiconductor sentiment.
Foreign selling of Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix after strong weekly rallies, with profit-taking risk.
vol_and_positioning: Foreigners were net sellers of KOSPI at US$1,212mn and of KOSDAQ at US$21mn. Locals bought KOSPI (+US$557mn) and retail bought both KOSPI (+US$465mn) and KOSDAQ (+US$127mn).
KOSPI turnover was 0.9% below its 20-day average.
SK Hynix drew Other Corporates inflow for a second day (+US$252mn) after the W20tn buyback announcement.
